adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `refreshOAuthTokens()` which, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`, returns the raw `fetch(...)` Response (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). Several integrations switched to `refreshOAuthTokens` but do not normalize/validate the returned token payload via `parseRefreshTokenResponse`. In particular, HubSpot now does `const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` (packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts) and then treats it like a token object, but in sync mode it will actually be a Response, causing broken behavior at runtime. Separately, Office365 video, Webex, and Lark also skip `parseRefreshTokenResponse`, so the "minimal token" contract implied by `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (accept only `access_token` + a numeric expiry and fabricate `refresh_token`) is not consistently applied across apps.
